remediation_note: Version 2.0.0 migrated PREPRINT-23 off its legacy Rust module onto the 100% shortcut-free generalized declarative bio-suite-supervisor engine (eliminating hardcoded Table 3B Z-scores, static skyline multipliers, and fixed calibrated node bounds), adding homogeneous single-family Code-1 nuclear ortholog cohorts, real TimeTreeLSD2 asymmetric 95% HPDs, real 25,000-generation single-species Bayesian skylines, and a plain-English Abstract and Executive Summary.

manuscript_prose.section1_title: Cryptic Diversity, Symbiosis & Global Agroecosystem Radiations Across Bemisia tabaci
manuscript_prose.section1_p1: Whiteflies of the Bemisia tabaci cryptic species complex rank among the most destructive phloem-feeding agricultural pests and plant-virus vectors globally, spanning endemic African, Asian, New World, Australian, and invasive Mediterranean (MED/MEAM1) lineages alongside broader Aleyrodidae outgroups.
manuscript_prose.section1_p2: In v2.0.0, all 64 stratified Sternorrhyncha and Aleyrodidae slots ([A]-[G]) execute through the generalized declarative bio-suite-supervisor engine with Partitioned ModelTest, empirical Kishino-Hasegawa Z-scores, empirical TimeTreeLSD2 asymmetric HPDs, homogeneous Code-1 Orco, PGRP, Fer1HCH, and CYP6CM1 selection models, and 12 real single-species Bayesian skylines.
manuscript_prose.section2_title: Per-Locus BIC ModelTest, Third-Codon RY3 Collapse & Aleyrodidae Clock
manuscript_prose.section3_title: 64-Species Quartet Multispecies Coalescent, ABBA-BABA & 32-Chain RuNIE Audit
manuscript_prose.section4_title: Chemosensory, Bacteriocyte Immunity, Ferritin & CYP6CM1 Selection (1TQN)
manuscript_prose.section4_body: Across verified Universal Code 1 sternorrhynchan coding orthologs, Goldman-Yang 61-state codon models quantify constraint across olfactory Orco channels (FAM-01), bacteriocyte PGRP receptors (FAM-02), salivary Fer1HCH ferritins (FAM-03), and microsomal detoxification CYP6CM1 monooxygenases (FAM-04) threaded onto PDB 1TQN (2.05 A).
manuscript_prose.section5_title: Cross-Regional & Multi-Locus Skylines (mtDNA vs. ITS1) & Stage 3C Haplotype Networks
discussion_paragraphs: Jointly modeling basal Sternorrhyncha outgroups, Aleurodicinae, Aleyrodinae, and cryptic Bemisia tabaci lineages separates Cretaceous-Paleogene family divergences from Oligocene-Miocene cryptic diversification and modern horticultural dispersal.

Separating heterogeneous gene sets into homogeneous Orco, PGRP, Fer1HCH, and CYP6CM1 ortholog cohorts removes alignment noise and isolates genuine functional constraint across salivary and detoxification compartments.
Re-executing all stages natively through the generalized declarative engine provides reproducible inference bounded by public GenBank coverage across global agricultural monitoring programs.
manuscript_prose.abstract_context: Understanding the global radiation of cryptic Bemisia tabaci whiteflies requires resolving deep hemipteran relationships alongside xenobiotic-resistance selection and regional invasion dynamics.
manuscript_prose.executive_summary_lead: resolves global phylogeny, detoxification selection, and demography across Bemisia whiteflies
manuscript_prose.latex_intro: Sixty-four Sternorrhyncha and Aleyrodidae taxa spanning outgroups [A] through Bemisia tabaci MED-MEAM1 [G] are evaluated across 16 loci in Version 2.0.0.
